CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 32
   C. 22
   D. 16

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

4. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 24.5

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

7. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 18
   C. 6
   D. 36

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 30
   C. 75
   D. 40

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 18
   C. 22
   D. 36

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 105

18. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

19. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 29

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 33
   C. 22
   D. 28

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

22. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 23
   C. 19
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
